qualifier: spanning ceramide/sphingomyelin synthesis and lysosomal glycosphingolipid catabolism
name: Ceramide, sphingomyelin and glycosphingolipid synthesis and lysosomal catabolism
rationale: All members concern sphingolipid synthesis, transport or degradation; unlike C1/C2 the theme includes glycosphingolipid/ganglioside and lysosomal breakdown, and unlike C3/C4 it includes ceramide and sphingomyelin synthesis and turnover.

name: Hippo kinase signaling and YAP/TAZ-driven transcription
rationale: Members cover Hippo pathway regulation, cell-density detection and YAP1/TAZ target expression; confusables are PTK6, RUNX3, WNT or PDGF/fibroblast programmes lacking the Hippo kinase core.

core: GDP-fucose and sugar-donor supply for Golgi glycosylation
name: GDP-fucose synthesis and fucose/sialic acid donor transporter CDGs
rationale: Members are GDP-fucose synthesis plus congenital glycosylation disorders of the Golgi GDP-fucose (SLC35C1) and CMP-sialic acid (SLC35A1) transporters, which the broader nucleotide-sugar confusables lack or dilute.

name: SREBP-regulated cholesterol synthesis and fatty acid nutrient responses
rationale: Members share SREBP control of cholesterol biosynthesis and lipid homeostasis with responses to fatty acid, fructose and caloric restriction, which distinguish it from cholesterol-transport (C1/C2) and nuclear-receptor lipid programmes (C3/C4).

qualifier: RUNX1 expression control and lineage-specific targets
name: RUNX1 expression control and lineage-specific target transcription
rationale: All members describe RUNX1 regulation or RUNX-driven transcription in hematopoietic, keratinocyte, WNT and estrogen contexts; confusables are Hox/TFAP2, FLT3 or erythroid-megakaryocyte programmes without RUNX1 regulation.

name: AKT activation via mTORC2 and PTEN stability control
rationale: Members cover AKT activation (TORC2, AKT1 E17K), cytosolic AKT targets and PTEN stability/localization; unlike C2/C3 it lacks ceRNA PTEN loss and has AKT activation, unlike C1/C4 it lacks phosphoinositide synthesis.

name: Actin filament severing, capping, depolymerization and crosslinking
rationale: Members are gelsolin-type actin filament severing, barbed-end capping, depolymerization and crosslinking (including caspase cleavage of cytoskeletal proteins), distinct from Arp2/3 nucleation, focal-adhesion bundling and filopodia confusables.

name: VEGFR2/Tie2-driven endothelial specification and vascular morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover VEGF/VEGFR2, neuropilin and Tie2 signaling with arterial, venous and lymphatic endothelial fate and vessel maturation, versus sprouting-angiogenesis regulation (C1/C2) and BMP-driven cardiovascular development (C3/C4).

name: Interleukin-1 precursor processing and IL-1 alpha production
rationale: All three members concern processing and production of IL-1 cytokine precursors, lacking the inflammasome/pyroptosis, IL-17 and IL-18 content of the confusables.

name: Linkage-specific ubiquitin chain assembly and deubiquitinase editing
rationale: Members are E1/E2/E3 ubiquitination, K6/K11/K27/K29/K48/K63 chain formation and DUB families; confusables add proteasome, protein quality control, neddylation or NF-kB regulation.

name: Downstream antigen-receptor signaling via second messengers and PKC
rationale: Members cover TCR-downstream second-messenger generation, ITK/PKC, NF-kB activation and IL-2 output (including the B-cell PKC-NF-kB arm), versus proximal CD3/ZAP-70 events (C1), CD28 costimulation (C3/C4) and non-canonical NF-kB (C2).

name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung and salivary branching morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signaling and proliferation driving lung, salivary and limb-bud outgrowth, unlike confusables centred on tracheal/alveolar lung development or prostate branching.

qualifier: ER store release and store-operated entry
name: Cytosolic calcium elevation via ER release and store-operated entry
rationale: Members concern raising cytosolic Ca2+ by release from ER stores and store-operated entry, whereas confusables emphasise Ca2+ reduction, ryanodine inhibition, cardiac contraction or ER-mitochondria tethering.

core: G1/S transition and DNA replication initiation
name: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and replication origin licensing
rationale: Members cover E2F target transcription, ORC/CDC6 pre-replicative complex assembly and replication initiation, unlike repair-focused (C1/C3), DREAM-repression (C2) and T-cell proliferation (C4) confusables.

name: TNF/TRAIL death-receptor control of apoptotic, necroptotic and autophagic death
rationale: Members regulate death-receptor extrinsic apoptosis, necroptosis and autophagic death including TRAIL and anti-tumour defense, versus mitochondrial apoptosis (C1), Fas/T-cell death (C2/C3) and RIPK1 necroptosis alone (C4).

qualifier: capacitation, acrosome reaction and zona penetration
name: Sperm capacitation, acrosome reaction and zona pellucida penetration
rationale: All members concern sperm capacitation, acrosome formation/exocytosis and zona/cumulus binding at fertilization, unlike sperm motility, spermatogenesis and maternal-to-zygotic transition confusables.

name: G2/M transition control with DREAM-mediated cell-cycle gene repression
rationale: Members cover G2 phase, cyclin B-CDK1, PLK and G2/M checkpoint events plus DREAM/p107-p130 repression of E2F targets, which C1 (p53 G2 arrest) lacks and which separates it from E2F G1/S confusables.

name: RAF-to-MAPK cascade activation, including oncogenic BRAF/RAF1/MEK mutants
rationale: Members cover RAF activation, MEK/ERK and RSK activation and RAF/MAP2K/MRAS mutant signaling, whereas confusables focus on upstream RAS-GAP/SOS regulation, integrin linkage or ERK inhibition.

name: Cytochrome P450 omega-hydroxylation and epoxygenation of fatty acids
rationale: Members cover CYP omega-hydroxylase (HETE) and epoxygenase (EET) metabolism of fatty acids and eicosanoids, including CYP4F22/SLC27A4 ichthyoses, unlike leukotriene (C1/C3) and lipoxygenase (C2/C4) confusables.

name: Exocyst-dependent Golgi-to-plasma-membrane delivery including GLUT4 translocation
rationale: Members regulate exocytic delivery of proteins to the cell surface via the exocyst and RHOQ, including GLUT4 translocation, unlike apical/raft/CFTR sorting (C1-C3) and glucose import confusables (C4).

name: T cell-dendritic cell immunological synapse and antigen presentation
rationale: Members cover synapse/raft assembly, T cell polarity and aggregation with antigen presentation, activated DC and IL-12 signaling, which homing, integrin-adhesion and RHO GTPase confusables lack.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar supply and CDG defects, excluding proteoglycans
name: Glycoprotein and glycolipid glycosylation, nucleotide-sugar supply and CDG defects
rationale: Most members concern N-glycan, O-GalNAc, GPI and glycosphingolipid synthesis, nucleotide-sugar supply and their congenital disorders, whereas confusables centre on O-fucose/Notch, dystroglycan or glycosaminoglycan/proteoglycan synthesis and degradation.

qualifier: polarized, to apical and raft domains
name: Polarized Golgi-to-plasma-membrane sorting to apical and raft domains
rationale: Members concern polarized apical/basolateral and membrane-raft protein delivery from the Golgi, without the CFTR/water transport (C1/C3/C4) or exocyst cell-surface (C2) content of the confusables.

name: IL-1/Toll-regulated production of IL-6, IL-8 and TNF
rationale: Members regulate inflammatory IL-6, IL-8, TNF and IL-1 production and IL-1/Toll signaling, unlike TLR3/4-specific (C1-C3) and inflammasome IL-1 processing (C4) confusables.

name: Osteoclast formation and bone resorption with IGF responsiveness
rationale: Members cover osteoclast differentiation, fusion and bone resorption plus IGF/peptide-hormone responses, versus macrophage fusion, osteoblast or mineralization confusables and C4, which lacks the osteoclast core.
